messages.content: What are the latest movie releases?

function.name: calculate_velocity
function.description: Calculate the final velocity of an object in motion given its initial velocity, acceleration and time. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_velocity.description: The initial velocity of the object in m/s. This is a float type value.

acceleration.description: The acceleration of the object in m/s^2. This is a float type value.

time.description: The time for which the object is in motion in seconds. This is a float type value.

message.content: I don’t have access to real‑time data, so I can’t pull up a current list of releases. Could you let me know which month or year you’re interested in, or if there’s a particular genre or region you’d like to focus on? That way I can give you the most relevant information I have.
message.reasoning: User asks "What are the latest movie releases?" We need to respond with a list of recent movies. But we have no browsing capability. We can provide general info or ask clarifying question. According to policy, we should not hallucinate. We can say we don't have real-time data. So we should ask user for more context or clarify timeframe. Probably ask what year or month.
